title: Book One · Chapter 157: A Practice Visitor
story:
On Tuesday, Miss Wu lets them use the display room. They have half an hour there. There are no visitors yet. The pictures are still in their covers. They have brought plain sheets the same size as the pictures. They can move these sheets around the room. The real pictures can stay safe in their covers.

Ronan puts the map paper near the door. Mei chooses the wall away from the sun. She puts her three paper shapes there. Leo takes the game papers to the long table. He puts them at the far end. They mark a stool place beside the resting chair. There is room to walk around both seats.

“I will be the first visitor,” Miss Wu says.

She steps outside and waits a moment. Then she comes in again. Ronan stands very straight by the map. He says welcome. Then he starts telling her about the room. He wants to explain every part.

She listens for a little while. Then she lifts one hand.

“May I come in?”

Ronan steps aside at once. He was standing in the doorway. Leo lifts a game card in front of his face. Ronan can hear him laughing.

Miss Wu walks to Mei's wall. Mei says the pictures will show three kinds of window. She asks the teacher not to touch the plain paper. Miss Wu puts her hands behind her back. She looks closely at the paper. She pretends she is looking at the real drawings.

At the game, Leo gives her two clues. She chooses the wrong door on purpose. He wants to tell her the right answer at once. But he waits. She reads the card again. She finds the answer herself.

“That felt better,” she says. “I got a turn too.”

They ask a girl to try next. She is in their class. She is shorter than Leo. Leo holds the paper cover too high. The girl cannot see one of the cards. He lowers it. Then she puts a clue by the wrong picture. Those two signs still look alike to her.

Bo tried the game before. Ronan made a note then. Now he takes it out. They have changed one sign, but not enough. Leo draws a large cup on the food shop. Ronan adds a pencil to Mr Qiu's table. Now the girl can see two different pictures. She can choose the right picture now.

Mei tries the route last. She carries a school bag. She pretends she is a visitor with things to carry. Her bag fits safely under the table. But nothing tells her to put it there yet. Leo puts his new bag sign there.

The half hour ends before they have fixed everything. Miss Wu looks around the room. “What must we do now?” she asks. Leo begins to gather the game. Mei takes the papers from the wall. Another child helps Ronan with the chairs. Together they put them back.

They find one small card under the table. They nearly left it there. On Saturday they might leave a real card under the table. Ronan adds FLOOR CHECK to the closing list.

They finish clearing. Mei looks at the clock. She writes the time on the trial paper. They have used part of their half hour to put the room back. Leo thinks of the stones they moved on the plan. Real visitors will take longer to leave. Miss Wu agrees. They keep four as the closing time. Adults can help visitors finish looking before then. After that, everyone can start putting the room back.

Back in class, Ronan feels better about the room. The practice visitor found some problems in the room. They still have time for changes. He writes his three changes on the list. The rest of the page stays empty.

At home Dad asks, “Did the practice go well?” Ronan tells him he kept the teacher outside her own room. Dad puts on a very serious face.

“A useful way to get a day off.”

Ronan laughs, then goes to finish his three jobs before supper.
studyGuide:
---

重点表达：practice＝练习、试行；on purpose＝故意地；closing list＝撤场清单。

情节提示：clue＝提示；route＝行走路线；trial paper＝试排用的纸。

理解：1. Ronan 的欢迎方式出了什么小问题？2. 试走帮助大家改进了哪些细节？
